! Master script - parameter validation and derived values
IF A < 0.30 THEN A = 0.30
IF B < 0.05 THEN B = 0.05
IF ZZYZX < 0.30 THEN ZZYZX = 0.30
IF n_cols < 2 THEN n_cols = 2
IF n_rows < 2 THEN n_rows = 2
IF bar_width_ratio < 0.05 THEN bar_width_ratio = 0.05
IF bar_width_ratio > 0.25 THEN bar_width_ratio = 0.25
IF frame_bar_ratio < 1.0 THEN frame_bar_ratio = 1.0
IF frame_bar_ratio > 4.0 THEN frame_bar_ratio = 4.0

IF petal_depth_ratio > 0.5 THEN petal_depth_ratio = 0.5

! Derived cell dimensions

! Petal geometry

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001
MATERIAL mat_body

! ============================================
! Step 1: Outer frame with inner void
! ============================================
! Frame outer rectangle, inner void - using PRISM_ with hole
! PRISM_ with status mask for hole: outer contour status=1, inner hole status=-1

! Outer frame: rectangular ring section, extruded to depth B
PRISM_ 10, B,
  0, 0, 1,
  A, 0, 1,
  A, ZZYZX, 1,
  0, ZZYZX, 1,
  0, 0, 1,
  _frame_w, _frame_w, -1,
  A - _frame_w, _frame_w, -1,
  A - _frame_w, ZZYZX - _frame_w, -1,
  _frame_w, ZZYZX - _frame_w, -1,
  _frame_w, _frame_w, -1

! ============================================
! Step 2: Grid bars (井字格底)
! ============================================
IF show_grid = 1 THEN
  ! Horizontal bars
  FOR j = 0 TO n_rows
    ADD 0, 0, _frame_w + j * _cell_h
    BLOCK A, B, _bar_w
    DEL 1
  NEXT j

  ! Vertical bars
  FOR i = 0 TO n_cols
    ADD _frame_w + i * _cell_w, 0, 0
    BLOCK _bar_w, B, ZZYZX
    DEL 1
  NEXT i
ENDIF

! ============================================
! Step 3: Quatrefoil (四瓣海棠) cells
! ============================================
FOR i = 1 TO n_cols
  FOR j = 1 TO n_rows
    ! Cell center position
    _cell_cx = _frame_w + (i - 0.5) * _cell_w
    _cell_cy = _frame_w + (j - 0.5) * _cell_h

    ADD _cell_cx, 0, _cell_cy
    GOSUB "DrawQuatrefoil"
    DEL 1
  NEXT j
NEXT i

! ============================================
! Step 4: Cross bars at cell centers
! ============================================
FOR i = 1 TO n_cols
  FOR j = 1 TO n_rows
    _cell_cx = _frame_w + (i - 0.5) * _cell_w
    _cell_cy = _frame_w + (j - 0.5) * _cell_h

    ADD _cell_cx, 0, _cell_cy
    GOSUB "DrawCross"
    DEL 1
  NEXT j
NEXT i

! ============================================
! Step 5: Half-petal border transitions
! ============================================
! Top and bottom borders
FOR i = 1 TO n_cols
  _cell_cx = _frame_w + (i - 0.5) * _cell_w

  ! Bottom border half-petal
  ADD _cell_cx, 0, _frame_w
  GOSUB "DrawHalfPetalDown"
  DEL 1

  ! Top border half-petal
  ADD _cell_cx, 0, ZZYZX - _frame_w
  GOSUB "DrawHalfPetalUp"
  DEL 1
NEXT i

! Left and right borders
FOR j = 1 TO n_rows
  _cell_cy = _frame_w + (j - 0.5) * _cell_h

  ! Left border half-petal
  ADD _frame_w, 0, _cell_cy
  GOSUB "DrawHalfPetalLeft"
  DEL 1

  ! Right border half-petal
  ADD A - _frame_w, 0, _cell_cy
  GOSUB "DrawHalfPetalRight"
  DEL 1
NEXT j

END

! ============================================
! Subroutine: DrawQuatrefoil
! Draws four-petal quatrefoil at origin (X-Z plane), extruded in Y
! ============================================
"DrawQuatrefoil":
  ! Single petal parameters
  _p_half_w = _cell_w * 0.5 - _bar_w * 0.5
  _p_half_h = _cell_h * 0.5 - _bar_w * 0.5
  _p_depth = MIN(_petal_depth, _p_half_w * 0.8, _p_half_h * 0.8)

  ! Draw 4 petals by rotation
  FOR k = 0 TO 3
    ROTZ k * 90
    GOSUB "DrawSinglePetal"
    DEL 1
  NEXT k
RETURN

! ============================================
! Subroutine: DrawSinglePetal
! Draws one petal pointing in +X direction from origin
! Petal shape: lens/vesica formed by two circular arcs
! ============================================
"DrawSinglePetal":
  ! Petal tip at (_p_depth, 0), base spans from (0, -_p_half_w) to (0, _p_half_w)
  ! Using POLY2_B to create closed petal shape, then EXTRUDE_

  ! Arc radius calculation: arc passes through tip and base corners
  _arc_r = (_p_depth * _p_depth + _p_half_w * _p_half_w) / (2 * _p_depth)

  ! Number of segments for smooth arc
  _n_seg = 8

  ! Build petal profile using PRISM_ (simpler than EXTRUDE_ for this case)
  ! Petal centered at origin, pointing right (+X in Z-X plane, so X coordinate)
  ! We work in X-Z plane: X is horizontal, Z is vertical in the cell

  ! Actually we need to be careful: we're in X-Z plane (ADD x, 0, z)
  ! Petal extends in +X direction from center, with width in Z direction

  ! Use POLY2_B for the petal outline, then extrude with PRISM_ equivalent
  ! Simpler: use BLOCK with rounded ends, or PRISM_ with curved edges

  ! Petal as PRISM_ with curved sides (status 1000 = curved edge)
  ! Base at x=0, tip at x=_p_depth, half-width at base = _p_half_w

  ! For simplicity and reliability: approximate petal with PRISM_ using straight segments
  ! or use POLY2_B with arc bulge

  ! Use PRISM_ with 6 points: base left, base right, mid curve right, tip, mid curve left, close
  ! With curved edges (b values for arcs)

  ! Actually use simpler approach: small BLOCK for petal body with rounded tip via CYLIND
  ! But that's complex. Use PRISM_ with arc approximation.

  ! Petal shape: two arcs meeting at tip
  ! We'll use 8-sided approximation for each arc half

  ! Total vertices for full petal outline: 2 (base) + 2*7 (arc approx) = 16, plus close
  ! Too many points. Use 6-point petal with b values for curvature.

  ! Simplified petal: diamond-like shape with curved sides
  ! PRISM_ n, h, x1, z1, b1, ...

  ! Petal vertices (in X-Z plane, Y extrusion):
  ! Base center-left, base left, curve to tip, tip, curve to base right, base center-right

  _pb_w = _p_half_w * 0.6  ! width at petal base (narrower than full)

  PRISM_ 7, B,
    0, -_pb_w, 1,
    0, -_p_half_w, 1000,
    _p_depth * 0.5, -_p_half_w * 0.7, 1000,
    _p_depth, 0, 1000,
    _p_depth * 0.5, _p_half_w * 0.7, 1000,
    0, _p_half_w, 1000,
    0, _pb_w, 1
RETURN

! ============================================
! Subroutine: DrawCross
! Small cross bar at cell center
! ============================================
"DrawCross":
  _cross_arm = MIN(_cell_w, _cell_h) * 0.15
  _cross_thk = _bar_w * 0.8

  ! Horizontal arm of cross
  ADD -_cross_arm, 0, -_cross_thk * 0.5
  BLOCK _cross_arm * 2, B, _cross_thk
  DEL 1

  ! Vertical arm of cross
  ADD -_cross_thk * 0.5, 0, -_cross_arm
  BLOCK _cross_thk, B, _cross_arm * 2
  DEL 1
RETURN

! ============================================
! Subroutine: DrawHalfPetalDown
! Half petal pointing down (-Z) for bottom border
! ============================================
"DrawHalfPetalDown":
  _p_half_w = _cell_w * 0.5 - _bar_w * 0.5
  _p_depth = MIN(_petal_depth, _p_half_w * 0.8)

  ! Half petal: similar to full but only lower half, truncated at base
  _pb_w = _p_half_w * 0.6

  PRISM_ 5, B,
    0, 0, 1,
    -_p_half_w, 0, 1000,
    -_p_half_w * 0.7, -_p_depth * 0.5, 1000,
    0, -_p_depth, 1000,
    _p_half_w * 0.7, -_p_depth * 0.5, 1000
RETURN

! ============================================
! Subroutine: DrawHalfPetalUp
! Half petal pointing up (+Z) for top border
! ============================================
"DrawHalfPetalUp":
  _p_half_w = _cell_w * 0.5 - _bar_w * 0.5
  _p_depth = MIN(_petal_depth, _p_half_w * 0.8)

  _pb_w = _p_half_w * 0.6

  PRISM_ 5, B,
    0, 0, 1,
    _p_half_w * 0.7, _p_depth * 0.5, 1000,
    0, _p_depth, 1000,
    -_p_half_w * 0.7, _p_depth * 0.5, 1000,
    -_p_half_w, 0, 1000
RETURN

! ============================================
! Subroutine: DrawHalfPetalLeft
! Half petal pointing left (-X) for left border
! ============================================
"DrawHalfPetalLeft":
  _p_half_w = _cell_h * 0.5 - _bar_w * 0.5  ! use cell height for vertical dimension
  _p_depth = MIN(_petal_depth, _p_half_w * 0.8)

  PRISM_ 5, B,
    0, 0, 1,
    -_p_depth, 0, 1000,
    -_p_depth * 0.5, -_p_half_w * 0.7, 1000,
    0, -_p_half_w, 1000,
    -_p_depth * 0.5, _p_half_w * 0.7, 1000
RETURN

! ============================================
! Subroutine: DrawHalfPetalRight
! Half petal pointing right (+X) for right border
! ============================================
"DrawHalfPetalRight":
  _p_half_w = _cell_h * 0.5 - _bar_w * 0.5
  _p_depth = MIN(_petal_depth, _p_half_w * 0.8)

  PRISM_ 5, B,
    0, 0, 1,
    _p_depth * 0.5, -_p_half_w * 0.7, 1000,
    0, -_p_half_w, 1000,
    -_p_depth * 0.5, _p_half_w * 0.7, 1000,
    _p_depth, 0, 1000
RETURN

! Validate parameters
IF A < 0.30 THEN A = 0.30
IF B < 0.02 THEN B = 0.02

IF n_random_points < 5 THEN n_random_points = 5

IF frame_bar_ratio < 1.0 THEN frame_bar_ratio = 1.0
IF frame_bar_ratio > 4.0 THEN frame_bar_ratio = 4.0
IF subdivisions < 4 THEN subdivisions = 4
IF subdivisions > 32 THEN subdivisions = 32

! Derived dimensions
_bar_w = bar_width_ratio
_frame_w = _bar_w * frame_bar_ratio
_inner_w = A - 2 * _frame_w
_inner_h = ZZYZX - 2 * _frame_w

! Ensure inner area remains valid
IF _inner_w < 0.10 THEN
    _inner_w = 0.10
    _frame_w = (A - _inner_w) / 2
ENDIF
IF _inner_h < 0.10 THEN
    _inner_h = 0.10
    _frame_w = (ZZYZX - _inner_h) / 2
ENDIF

! Inner region bounds
_inner_x0 = _frame_w
_inner_y0 = _frame_w
_inner_x1 = A - _frame_w
_inner_z1 = ZZYZX - _frame_w

! Total point count: boundary points + interior random points
_total_points = subdivisions * 4 + n_random_points

! Initialize random seed
SEED random_seed

! Store points in arrays: px[1.._total_points], py[1.._total_points]
! Boundary points (counter-clockwise, starting bottom-left)
! Bottom edge
FOR i = 1 TO subdivisions
    px[i] = _inner_x0 + (i - 1) * _inner_w / (subdivisions - 1)
    py[i] = _inner_y0
NEXT i

! Right edge
FOR i = 1 TO subdivisions
    px[subdivisions + i] = _inner_x1
    py[subdivisions + i] = _inner_y0 + (i - 1) * _inner_h / (subdivisions - 1)
NEXT i

! Top edge
FOR i = 1 TO subdivisions
    px[2 * subdivisions + i] = _inner_x1 - (i - 1) * _inner_w / (subdivisions - 1)
    py[2 * subdivisions + i] = _inner_z1
NEXT i

! Left edge
FOR i = 1 TO subdivisions
    px[3 * subdivisions + i] = _inner_x0
    py[3 * subdivisions + i] = _inner_z1 - (i - 1) * _inner_h / (subdivisions - 1)
NEXT i

! Interior random points with minimum spacing constraint
_np_boundary = subdivisions * 4
FOR i = 1 TO n_random_points
    ! Generate candidate point with rejection sampling for minimum spacing
    _max_attempts = 50
    _attempt = 0
    _accepted = 0
    WHILE _accepted = 0 AND _attempt < _max_attempts DO
        _attempt = _attempt + 1
        _cand_x = _inner_x0 + RND(1) * _inner_w
        _cand_y = _inner_y0 + RND(1) * _inner_h
        
        ! Check minimum spacing against existing points
        _min_dist = _inner_w
        IF _inner_h < _min_dist THEN _min_dist = _inner_h
        _min_dist = _min_dist * 0.08  ! relative minimum spacing
        
        _too_close = 0
        _j = 1
        WHILE _j <= _np_boundary + i - 1 AND _too_close = 0 DO
            _dx = _cand_x - px[_j]
            _dy = _cand_y - py[_j]
            _dist = SQR(_dx * _dx + _dy * _dy)
            IF _dist < _min_dist AND _dist > 0.001 THEN _too_close = 1
            _j = _j + 1
        ENDWHILE
        
        IF _too_close = 0 THEN
            _accepted = 1
            px[_np_boundary + i] = _cand_x
            py[_np_boundary + i] = _cand_y
        ENDIF
    ENDWHILE
    
    ! If all attempts failed, use grid-based fallback
    IF _accepted = 0 THEN
        _grid_cols = INT(SQR(n_random_points)) + 1
        _grid_rows = INT(n_random_points / _grid_cols) + 1
        _col = MOD(i - 1, _grid_cols)
        _row = INT((i - 1) / _grid_cols)
        px[_np_boundary + i] = _inner_x0 + (_col + 0.5) * _inner_w / _grid_cols
        py[_np_boundary + i] = _inner_y0 + (_row + 0.5) * _inner_h / _grid_rows
    ENDIF
NEXT i

! Simplified triangulation: use point-to-nearest-neighbors connection
! For each point, connect to k nearest neighbors to form edges
! Store edges in arrays: e1[1.._max_edges], e2[1.._max_edges]
_max_edges = _total_points * 6
_edge_count = 0

FOR i = 1 TO _total_points
    ! Find up to 6 nearest neighbors
    FOR k = 1 TO 6
        _best_j = 0
        _best_dist = 1e10
        FOR j = 1 TO _total_points
            IF i = j THEN GOTO 100
            ! Check if edge already exists
            _exists = 0
            FOR e = 1 TO _edge_count
                IF (e1[e] = i AND e2[e] = j) OR (e1[e] = j AND e2[e] = i) THEN
                    _exists = 1
                    e = _edge_count  ! break inner loop
                ENDIF
            NEXT e
            IF _exists = 1 THEN GOTO 100
            
            _dx = px[j] - px[i]
            _dy = py[j] - py[i]
            _dist = _dx * _dx + _dy * _dy  ! squared distance, no sqrt for speed
            
            ! Prefer connections that don't cross boundary too sharply
            _penalty = 0
            IF i <= _np_boundary AND j <= _np_boundary THEN
                ! Both on boundary, penalize long edges along boundary
                _bi = i
                _bj = j
                IF _bi > _np_boundary THEN _bi = _bi - _np_boundary
                IF _bj > _np_boundary THEN _bj = _bj - _np_boundary
                _bdiff = ABS(_bi - _bj)
                IF _bdiff > _np_boundary / 2 THEN _bdiff = _np_boundary - _bdiff
                IF _bdiff > 2 THEN _penalty = _dist * 0.5
            ENDIF
            
            _dist = _dist + _penalty
            
            IF _dist < _best_dist THEN
                _best_dist = _dist
                _best_j = j
            ENDIF
        100:
        NEXT j
        
        IF _best_j > 0 THEN
            _edge_count = _edge_count + 1
            IF _edge_count <= _max_edges THEN
                e1[_edge_count] = i
                e2[_edge_count] = _best_j
            ELSE
                _edge_count = _max_edges
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    NEXT k
NEXT i

! Limit edge count
IF _edge_count > _max_edges THEN _edge_count = _max_edges

    BLOCK _len, _bar_w, B
    DEL 1
    
    ! Undo rotations and translation
    DEL 2
    DEL 1

    ! 随机角度

    _angle_rad = _angle * PI / 180
    
    ! 起点：内圆上或圆心附近

    _dy = _y2 - _y1
    _len = SQR(_dx * _dx + _dy * _dy)

            _x2 + _nx, _y2 + _ny, 1,
            _x2 - _nx, _y2 - _ny, 1,
            _x1 - _nx, _y1 - _ny, 1
    ENDIF
NEXT i
